units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: д) the procedure for interaction between the software and hardware of participants in the contractual procurement system and that system;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: е) requirements for ensuring the confidentiality of information contained in that system.
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 4 Part 14 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Information support for the contractual procurement system
units.text: 15. Information and documents provided for by this Federal Law that are generated and drawn up by a contracting authority, other than those generated and published in the unified information system and/or on an electronic platform or specialized electronic platform, and those received by the contracting authority when determining, under this Federal Law, the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the initial unit prices of goods, works or services, the initial total of those unit prices or the maximum contract price, or when justifying that initial (maximum) price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), or the initial unit prices of goods, works or services (except information and documents included in a contract as justification of the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under part 4 of Article 93 of this Federal Law), shall be retained by the contracting authority for at least six years from the start of procurement.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1. Within the relations specified in part 1 of Article 1 of this Federal Law, participants in the contractual procurement system may exchange electronic documents provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, including applications to participate in the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers). Those applications and electronic documents sent during the selection of suppliers (contractors, service providers) or contract performance must be signed with an enhanced electronic signature. In the cases provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, electronic documents shall be exchanged through the unified information system.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2. Qualified certificates of electronic signature verification keys intended for use by participants in the contractual procurement system for the purposes of this Federal Law shall be created and issued by certification centres accredited as meeting the requirements of Federal Law of 6 April 2011 No. 63-FZ “On Electronic Signatures”. Procurement participants that are foreign persons may sign information and electronic documents provided for by this Federal Law using electronic signatures created in accordance with the law of a foreign state and international standards and recognized in the Russian Federation. The surname and initials of the holder of the qualified electronic signature verification key certificate who signed information and documents provided for by this Federal Law and subject to publication in the unified information system shall be published in that system.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 3. Uniform document forms shall be used when generating and publishing information and documents in the unified information system and on an electronic platform or specialized electronic platform, and when drawing up documents under this Federal Law. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish requirements for those forms and the procedure for generating and publishing information and documents in the unified information system and on an electronic platform or specialized electronic platform.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 4. Where data contained in the unified information system contradict data contained in information and documents sent by participants in the contractual system, the information contained in the unified information system shall prevail.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 5. Information and documents published under this Federal Law on the official website or on an electronic platform must be available for viewing there no later than one hour after their publication, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law. Charging for access to such information and documents is prohibited.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 6. No later than one hour after amendments to a procurement notice, clarifications of a procurement notice or a notice cancelling procurement are published in the unified information system under this Federal Law, the electronic platform operator shall publish that information and those documents on the electronic platform and, through the platform, notify all procurement participants who have submitted applications to participate in that procurement, and the person who requested clarification of the procurement notice, of those amendments, clarifications or notice.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 7. Unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law, an electronic platform operator or specialized electronic platform operator must ensure the confidentiality of information about a procurement participant that has submitted information and documents, and of their contents, until that information and those documents are sent to the contracting authority under this Federal Law. This requirement does not apply to procurement conducted under part 12 of Article 93 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Organization of document circulation in the contractual procurement system
units.text: 8. Information and documents generated and published in the unified information system under this Federal Law shall be retained by one or more federal executive bodies designated under part 6 of Article 4 of this Federal Law for at least six years after completion of procurement in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 6. Principles of the contractual procurement system
units.text: Article 6. Principles of the contractual procurement system
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Principles of the contractual procurement system
units.text: The contractual procurement system is based on the principles of openness and transparency of information about the contractual procurement system, ensuring competition, professionalism of contracting authorities, encouraging innovation, unity of the contractual procurement system, responsibility for effectively meeting state and municipal needs, and efficiency of procurement.
units.label: Art. 6 · text

units.locator: Article 7. Principles of openness and transparency
units.text: Article 7. Principles of openness and transparency
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Principles of openness and transparency
units.text: 1. Free and unrestricted access to information about the contractual procurement system shall be ensured in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Principles of openness and transparency
units.text: 2. Openness and transparency of the information specified in part 1 of this Article shall be ensured, in particular, by publishing it in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Principles of openness and transparency
units.text: 3. Information provided for by this Federal Law and published in the unified information system must be complete and reliable.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 8. Principle of ensuring competition
units.text: Article 8. Principle of ensuring competition
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Principle of ensuring competition
units.text: 1. The contractual procurement system is aimed at creating equal conditions to ensure competition among procurement participants. Any interested person has the opportunity, in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, to become a supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Principle of ensuring competition
units.text: 2. Competition in procurement must be based on compliance with the principle of fair price and non-price competition among procurement participants, with the aim of identifying the best terms for supplying goods, performing works and providing services. Contracting authorities, specialized organizations, their officials, procurement commissions, members of such commissions, procurement participants, electronic platform operators and specialized electronic platform operators are prohibited from taking any actions that contravene this Federal Law, including actions that restrict competition, in particular by unreasonably limiting the number of procurement participants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 9. Principle of the contracting authority's professionalism
units.text: Article 9. Principle of the contracting authority's professionalism
units.label: Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Principle of the contracting authority's professionalism
units.text: 1. The contractual procurement system provides for contracting authorities, specialized organizations and procurement control bodies to operate on a professional basis, engaging qualified specialists with theoretical knowledge and skills in procurement.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 9. Principle of the contracting authority's professionalism
units.text: 2. Contracting authorities and specialized organizations shall take measures to maintain and improve the qualifications and professional education of officials engaged in procurement, including through further training or professional retraining in procurement in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 9

units.locator: Article 10. Principle of encouraging innovation
units.text: Article 10. Principle of encouraging innovation
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Principle of encouraging innovation
units.text: In planning and conducting procurement, contracting authorities must give priority to meeting state and municipal needs through procurement of innovative and high-technology products.
units.label: Art. 10 · text

units.locator: Article 11. Principle of the unity of the contractual procurement system
units.text: Article 11. Principle of the unity of the contractual procurement system
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Principle of the unity of the contractual procurement system
units.text: The contractual procurement system is based on uniform principles and approaches provided for by this Federal Law that enable state and municipal needs to be met through procurement planning and implementation, procurement monitoring, procurement audit and procurement control.
units.label: Art. 11 · text

units.locator: Article 12. Principle of responsibility for effectively meeting state and municipal needs and for efficient procurement
units.text: Article 12. Principle of responsibility for effectively meeting state and municipal needs and for efficient procurement
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Principle of responsibility for effectively meeting state and municipal needs and for efficient procurement
units.text: 1. When planning and conducting procurement, state bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds, municipal bodies, treasury institutions and, in the cases established by this Federal Law, other legal entities must proceed from the need to achieve the specified results in meeting state and municipal needs.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Principle of responsibility for effectively meeting state and municipal needs and for efficient procurement
units.text: 2. Officials of contracting authorities bear personal responsibility for compliance with requirements established by legislation of the Russian Federation on the contractual procurement system and the regulatory legal acts specified in parts 2 and 3 of Article 2 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12

units.text: Article 13. Repealed

units.text: Article 13. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 27.06.2019 No. 152-FZ.

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 1. National treatment shall be granted in procurement, ensuring that goods originating in a foreign state or group of foreign states (hereinafter, a foreign state), and works performed or services provided, respectively, by a foreign citizen or foreign legal entity (hereinafter, a foreign person), enjoy equal conditions with goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by a Russian citizen or Russian legal entity (hereinafter, a Russian person), except where the Government of the Russian Federation adopts measures provided for by point 1 of part 2 of this Article. Unless otherwise provided by the measures adopted by the Government of the Russian Federation under point 1 of part 2 of this Article, the provisions of this Article concerning goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by a Russian person shall also apply to goods originating in a foreign state and works performed or services provided, respectively, by a foreign person that are granted equal conditions with goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by a Russian person.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 2. The Government of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 1) may, subject to part 3 of this Article, adopt measures establishing:
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: а) a prohibition on procurement of goods originating in foreign states, including goods supplied in performing the works or providing the services being procured, and of works performed or services provided, respectively, by foreign persons;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: б) a restriction on procurement of goods originating in foreign states, including goods supplied in performing the works or providing the services being procured, and of works performed or services provided, respectively, by foreign persons;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: в) a preference for goods of Russian origin, including goods supplied in performing the works or providing the services being procured, and for works performed or services provided, respectively, by Russian persons;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 2) shall determine the information and list of documents confirming the country of origin of goods for the purposes of this Federal Law where measures provided for by point 1 of this part are adopted.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 3. The Government of the Russian Federation may adopt measures provided for by point 1 of part 2 of this Article where an international treaty of the Russian Federation allows national treatment to be withheld from goods originating in a foreign state or works performed or services provided, respectively, by a person registered in a foreign state.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 4. In procurement of goods:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 1) where the Government of the Russian Federation has established the prohibition on procurement of goods provided for by subpoint “а” of point 1 of part 2 of this Article:
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: а) an application to participate in procurement that offers to supply such goods originating in a foreign state shall be rejected in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: б) conclusion of a contract with a sole supplier for the supply of such goods originating in a foreign state is prohibited;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: в) during contract performance, replacing such goods with goods originating in a foreign state and subject to that prohibition is prohibited;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 2) where the Government of the Russian Federation has established the restriction on procurement of goods provided for by subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 2 of this Article:
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: а) all applications to participate in procurement offering to supply such goods originating in a foreign state shall be rejected under this Federal Law if an application offering to supply such goods of Russian origin has been submitted and, following examination, found to meet the requirements of the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where procurement documentation is provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: б) where a contract provides for the supply of goods of Russian origin, replacing those goods during contract performance with goods originating in a foreign state and subject to that restriction is prohibited;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 3) where the Government of the Russian Federation has established the preference for goods of Russian origin provided for by subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 2 of this Article:
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: а) when assigning a ranking to an application to participate in procurement offering to supply only goods of Russian origin under subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 15 of Article 48, subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 5 of Article 49, subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 3 of Article 50, subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 10 of Article 73, point 1 of part 5 of Article 74, subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 9 of Article 75, or subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 5 of Article 76 of this Federal Law, that participant’s price offer shall be reduced by fifteen percent, or increased by fifteen percent where the participant offers an amount to be paid for the right to conclude the contract. When assigning a ranking under subpoint “б” of point 6 of part 12 of Article 93 of this Federal Law to an application offering to supply only goods of Russian origin, the unit price offered by the participant that submitted that application shall be reduced by fifteen percent;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: б) if a contract is concluded with the procurement participant specified in subpoint “а” of this point, it shall be concluded without taking account of the reduction in the price offer or unit price, or the increase in the price offer, made under subpoint “а” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: в) where a contract provides for the supply of goods of Russian origin, goods may be replaced during contract performance only with goods of Russian origin.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 4 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 5. In procurement of works or services:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 1) where the Government of the Russian Federation has established the prohibition, provided for by subpoint “а” of point 1 of part 2 of this Article, on procurement of works performed or services provided, respectively, by a foreign person:
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: а) an application to participate in that procurement submitted by a foreign person shall be rejected in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: б) conclusion of a contract for those works or services with a sole contractor (service provider) that is a foreign person is prohibited;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 2) where the Government of the Russian Federation has established the restriction, provided for by subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 2 of this Article, on procurement of such works performed or services provided, respectively, by a foreign person, all applications to participate in that procurement submitted by foreign persons shall be rejected under this Federal Law if an application submitted by a Russian person has, following examination, been found to meet the requirements of the procurement notice and procurement documentation, where procurement documentation is provided for by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 3) where the Government of the Russian Federation has established the preference, provided for by subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 2 of this Article, for works performed or services provided, respectively, by a Russian person:
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: а) when assigning a ranking to an application to participate in procurement submitted by a Russian person under subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 15 of Article 48, subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 5 of Article 49, subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 3 of Article 50, subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 10 of Article 73, point 1 of part 5 of Article 74, subpoint “в” of point 1 of part 9 of Article 75, or subpoint “б” of point 1 of part 5 of Article 76 of this Federal Law, that participant’s price offer shall be reduced by fifteen percent, or increased by fifteen percent where the participant offers an amount to be paid for the right to conclude the contract. When assigning a ranking under subpoint “б” of point 6 of part 12 of Article 93 of this Federal Law to an application submitted by a Russian person, the price offered by that participant for granting the right to use a computer program and/or database, including their updates and additional functionality, including by providing remote access through information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, shall be reduced by fifteen percent;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: б) if a contract is concluded with the procurement participant specified in subpoint “а” of this point, that contract shall be concluded without taking account of the reduction or increase in the price offer made under subpoint “а” of this point.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 5 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 6. Following the end of a year, before 1 February of the year following the reporting year, a report on the volume of procurement of goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by Russian persons shall be published in the unified information system. It shall be generated by processing information held in that system and included in the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities, and by the contracting authority generating information on the volume of procurement whose information is not to be published in the unified information system under this Federal Law. In the cases established under part 8 of this Article where that report is not to be published in the unified information system, the contracting authority shall prepare it and send it, before 1 February of the year following the reporting year, to the federal executive body specified in part 7 of this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Granting national treatment in procurement
units.text: 7. The federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation shall examine the reports provided for by part 6 of this Article on the volume of procurement of goods of Russian origin and works performed or services provided, respectively, by Russian persons, and evaluate the results of such procurement during the reporting year, before 1 March of the year following the reporting year.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14
